lieu: living room of a modest apartment in Port-Bouet, Abidjan, sofa with lace covers, ceiling fan, evening

persos.nom: the wife holding her husband's phone
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, yellow-and-blue wax dress, braids in a high bun, holding up her husband's phone
persos.pose: showing the phone screen, furious

persos.nom: the husband on the sofa
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, grey polo shirt, small belly, remote control in hand
persos.pose: frozen on the sofa, guilty smile

dialogue: Pourquoi tu m'as enregistrée : Délestage ?!
Parce que quand tu arrives, toute la joie s'éteint.
jeu: The wife shoves the phone in his face. The husband answers honestly, then realizes his mistake and sinks into the sofa.

lieu: small kitchen in Abobo, Abidjan, open fridge that is completely empty except for one bottle of water, evening

persos.nom: the wife with the pregnancy test
persos.desc: young wife in her 20s, pink t-shirt, wax wrap skirt, holding a pregnancy test with joy
persos.pose: jumping with happiness

persos.nom: the husband looking in the fridge
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, white singlet, bermuda shorts, standing in front of the empty fridge
persos.pose: staring into the empty fridge, then at her

dialogue: Chéri ! Je suis enceinte !
Dis au bébé de patienter. La fin du mois n'est pas arrivée.
jeu: The wife announces the news with joy. The husband looks at the empty fridge, then answers very seriously.

lieu: terrace of a house in Cocody, Abidjan, two rattan chairs, potted plants, sunset

persos.nom: the romantic wife
persos.desc: wife in her 40s, elegant green boubou, gold jewelry, dreamy smile
persos.pose: hands on her heart, romantic

persos.nom: the husband with the thick glasses
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, white kaftan, putting on very thick glasses
persos.pose: slowly putting on his glasses and looking at her

dialogue: Chéri, on dit que l'amour rend aveugle.
Oui. Et le mariage m'a rendu la vue.
jeu: The wife speaks romantically. The husband slowly puts on his thick glasses, looks at her and answers.

lieu: busy roadside chicken grill in Yopougon, Abidjan, smoke, braised chickens on a barbecue grill, night

persos.nom: the girlfriend in the white dress
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, white dress, small handbag, phone in hand, shocked
persos.pose: pointing at her boyfriend at the grill

persos.nom: the boyfriend grilling chicken
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, sweaty, apron covered in sauce, fanning the grill with cardboard
persos.pose: fanning the grill, caught red-handed

dialogue: Tu m'as dit que tu es médecin !
Oui, bébé. Je soigne les poulets braisés.
jeu: The girlfriend discovers him and shouts. He shows a chicken on the grill like a patient and answers proudly.

lieu: bedroom window at night in Abobo, Abidjan, a young man with a guitar standing outside under the window, moonlight

persos.nom: the young man with the guitar
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, flower shirt, old guitar with one string, rose in his teeth
persos.pose: singing romantically under the window

persos.nom: the girl at the window
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, hair in a headscarf, leaning out of the window
persos.pose: leaning out, touched, hands on her cheeks

dialogue: Ma chérie, je t'ai écrit une chanson !
Chante !
Elle s'appelle : prête-moi cinq mille.
jeu: The young man plays one note dramatically. The girl is touched, then her face falls when he announces the title.

lieu: town hall wedding room in Abidjan, flags, a desk with a big register, rows of guests

persos.nom: the mayor with the sash
persos.desc: mayor in his 60s, dark suit with an orange-white-green sash, reading glasses
persos.pose: reading the register solemnly

persos.nom: the groom in the cream suit
persos.desc: nervous groom in his 30s, cream suit, bow tie
persos.pose: looking nervously at the mother-in-law

persos.nom: the bride in the white dress
persos.desc: bride in her 20s, white wedding dress, veil
persos.pose: smiling

persos.nom: the mother-in-law in the front row
persos.desc: huge mother-in-law in her 60s, giant purple headwrap, arms crossed, judging stare
persos.pose: sitting in the front row, arms crossed

dialogue: Monsieur, acceptez-vous de prendre Madame pour épouse ?
Sa maman est comprise dans le paquet ?
jeu: The mayor asks solemnly. The groom glances at the scary mother-in-law and asks his question timidly.

lieu: living room in Marcory, Abidjan, a pile of bills and debt notices on the table, packed suitcase by the door

persos.nom: the angry wife with the suitcase
persos.desc: angry wife in her 30s, red wax dress, headwrap, dragging a suitcase
persos.pose: pointing at her husband, ready to leave

persos.nom: the calm husband with the bills
persos.desc: calm husband in his 40s, blue shirt, holding a thick stack of unpaid bills
persos.pose: calmly holding out the stack of bills

dialogue: Je veux le divorce !
D'accord. On partage les dettes aussi.
Euh… on peut encore parler, chéri.
jeu: The wife announces the divorce. The husband calmly hands her half of the bills. She drops the suitcase and smiles awkwardly.

lieu: shared courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, laundry line, father and son sitting on a mat, a small pot of rice

persos.nom: the curious son
persos.desc: curious boy around 9, yellow t-shirt, big round eyes
persos.pose: asking with his chin in his hands

persos.nom: the wise father
persos.desc: father in his 40s, faded brown kaftan, cap, eating rice with his hand
persos.pose: answering wisely, finger raised

dialogue: Papa, c'est quoi la différence entre riche et pauvre ?
Le riche mange quand il a faim. Nous, on mange quand on trouve.
jeu: The son asks innocently. The father answers like a philosopher while scraping the bottom of the pot.

lieu: dusty street in front of a family house in Abobo, Abidjan, afternoon, a kiosk and parked motorbikes

persos.nom: the little boy with the big ears
persos.desc: little boy around 8, very big ears, big gap between his front teeth, round face, red t-shirt
persos.pose: looking up at his father, worried

persos.nom: the skinny father with tiny ears
persos.desc: very skinny tall father in his 40s, long thin face, tiny ears, perfect teeth, beige shirt
persos.pose: hand on his heart, proud

persos.nom: the neighbor with the big ears
persos.desc: chubby neighbor in his 40s with exactly the same face as the boy: very big ears, big gap between his front teeth, round face, red shirt
persos.pose: walking past in the background, waving

dialogue: Papa, à l'école ils disent que je ne te ressemble pas.
Jaloux ! Tu es mon portrait craché !
Bonjour, fiston !
jeu: The boy speaks sadly. The father answers proudly and hugs him. The neighbor waves cheerfully as he walks past.
chute: The father slowly turns his head to the neighbor, then back to the boy, comparing their identical big ears and gap teeth. End on a close-up of the father's devastated face staring into the camera.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, toy doctor kit on the floor, family photos on the wall

persos.nom: the little girl with the toy stethoscope
persos.desc: little girl around 7, toy stethoscope, white t-shirt, braids with beads
persos.pose: listening to her father's chest with the toy stethoscope

persos.nom: the father with the empty wallet
persos.desc: father in his 40s, beige shirt, holding an open empty wallet
persos.pose: handing her his empty wallet

dialogue: Papa, je veux devenir médecin !
Commence par soigner mon porte-monnaie. Il est malade depuis ta naissance.
jeu: The girl plays doctor proudly. The father hands her his empty wallet like a patient.

lieu: shared courtyard in Treichville, Abidjan, a father reading a school report card, plastic chairs

persos.nom: the proud boy with the report card
persos.desc: boy around 10, school uniform, holding his report card proudly
persos.pose: puffing his chest proudly

persos.nom: the father in the blue boubou
persos.desc: father in his 40s, blue boubou, reading glasses
persos.pose: clapping, then frowning

dialogue: Papa ! Je suis deuxième de la classe !
Bravo ! Vous êtes combien ?
Deux.
jeu: The boy announces proudly. The father claps with joy, then freezes at the answer.

lieu: family kitchen in Koumassi, Abidjan, big pot of sauce on the stove, lid open

persos.nom: the mother with the ladle
persos.desc: mother in her 40s, green wax dress, headwrap, holding a ladle
persos.pose: pointing the ladle at her son, furious

persos.nom: the boy with sauce on his mouth
persos.desc: boy around 8, white t-shirt with sauce stains, sauce all around his mouth
persos.pose: hiding a piece of meat behind his back, innocent face

dialogue: Qui a mangé la viande dans la sauce ?!
C'est le chat, maman !
On n'a pas de chat !
Il est venu, il a mangé, il est parti.
jeu: The mother shouts. The boy points at the window with his sauce-covered mouth and explains calmly.

lieu: front yard of a modest house in Abobo, Abidjan, an old father telling a story to his teenage son

persos.nom: the father with the torn sandals
persos.desc: father in his 50s, torn sandals, old patched shirt, proud posture
persos.pose: telling his story with big gestures

persos.nom: the teenage son
persos.desc: teenage son around 16, school uniform, backpack, raised eyebrow
persos.pose: listening, unimpressed

dialogue: À ton âge, je marchais dix kilomètres pour l'école !
Et tu es arrivé où avec ça, papa ?
jeu: The father brags proudly. The son looks at the father's torn sandals and answers calmly.

lieu: supermarket aisle in Abidjan, shelves of rice and oil, a security camera on the ceiling

persos.nom: the grandmother with the empty basket
persos.desc: grandmother in her 70s, blue wax dress, headwrap, holding an empty shopping basket
persos.pose: telling her story nostalgically

persos.nom: the grandson with the cart
persos.desc: grandson in his 20s, white t-shirt, pushing a shopping cart
persos.pose: pointing at the security camera

dialogue: À mon époque, avec cent francs, je ramenais riz, huile et poisson !
Mamie, aujourd'hui il y a des caméras partout.
jeu: The grandmother remembers proudly. The grandson points discreetly at the security camera.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, evening, old sofa, TV on, family photos on the wall

persos.nom: the little girl with the afro
persos.desc: curious little girl around 9, short puffy afro with a red headband, denim overalls over a white t-shirt
persos.pose: sitting next to her mother, asking innocently

persos.nom: the mother with the round glasses
persos.desc: slim elegant mother in her 40s, short natural hair with grey streaks, round glasses, turquoise blouse and long black skirt
persos.pose: looking at her sleeping husband with a long sigh

persos.nom: the bald father snoring
persos.desc: bald father in his 50s with a thick grey mustache and a big round belly, faded maroon tracksuit top, asleep on the sofa with the TV remote on his belly, mouth open
persos.pose: snoring on the other end of the sofa

dialogue: Maman, pourquoi tu as marié papa-là ?
Ma fille… À l'époque, il avait cheveux et salaire dêh !
Et toi, tu avais taille fine !
jeu: The girl asks innocently. The mother sighs, looking at her snoring husband. The father answers without opening his eyes, then keeps snoring.
chute: The mother slowly turns toward the father with murderous eyes while the girl quietly slides off the sofa. End on a close-up of the little girl looking into the camera with an 'oh no' face.

lieu: terrace of a busy maquis in Yopougon, Abidjan, plastic table with a big plate of braised chicken and attieke, string lights, evening

persos.nom: the big friend eating chicken
persos.desc: big jovial man in his 30s, tight yellow polo shirt, eating a huge braised chicken with his hands
persos.pose: pointing a chicken leg at his friend, amazed

persos.nom: the very thin friend
persos.desc: comically skeleton-thin man in his 30s, arms and neck as thin as sticks, hollow cheeks, wearing a white shirt three sizes too big that hangs on him like a tent, belt with extra holes pulled very tight
persos.pose: sitting proudly, pinching his huge loose shirt to show how big it is

dialogue: Mon vieux, tu as maigri dêh ! C'est le sport ?
Non. C'est la fin du mois… depuis trois mois.
jeu: The big friend is amazed. The thin friend answers proudly while staring hungrily at the chicken.
chute: The big friend slowly pulls his plate of chicken back and hides it under the table, avoiding eye contact. End on a close-up of the thin friend staring into the camera with a deadpan face.

lieu: garba stall in Abobo, Abidjan, big bowl of attieke, fried tuna pieces, wooden table, plastic plates

persos.nom: the hungry customer
persos.desc: hungry young man in his 20s, construction worker vest, holding out a plate of attieke
persos.pose: holding out his plate, begging

persos.nom: the garba seller with the tongs
persos.desc: garba seller in her 40s, red headscarf, apron, holding a tiny piece of tuna with tongs
persos.pose: placing one tiny piece of tuna on the plate

dialogue: Tantie, mets beaucoup de thon, dêh !
Voilà. Le thon est timide aujourd'hui.
jeu: The customer begs. The seller places one tiny piece of tuna on the huge pile of attieke and answers sweetly.

persos.nom: the customer with the phone

persos.pose: pointing at the tomatoes

persos.nom: the tomato seller
persos.desc: tomato seller in her 50s, orange headwrap, sitting behind a pyramid of tomatoes
persos.pose: holding up one tomato proudly

dialogue: La tomate est à combien ?
Trois cents l'une.
Donne-moi juste la photo alors.
jeu: The customer asks. The seller answers proudly. The customer raises her phone and takes a photo of the tomato.

lieu: dusty road in Abobo, Abidjan, a young man walking barefoot holding new shoes in his hands, his friend beside him

persos.nom: the friend in the tracksuit
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, black tracksuit, sneakers
persos.pose: pointing at his friend's feet, confused

persos.nom: the barefoot man with new shoes
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, white shirt, jeans rolled up, barefoot, holding shiny new shoes against his chest
persos.pose: walking barefoot, protecting his shoes like a baby

dialogue: Pourquoi tu marches avec tes chaussures à la main ?
Elles sont neuves. Je ne veux pas les fatiguer.
jeu: The friend asks, confused. The barefoot man hugs his shoes tenderly and answers.

persos.nom: the excited girlfriend
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, pink dress, sunglasses, hands clasped with excitement
persos.pose: hands clasped, very excited

persos.nom: the boyfriend holding a brick
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, yellow shirt, holding a single cement brick with a red ribbon
persos.pose: presenting the brick proudly

Wouah ! Elle est où ?
Voilà la première brique.
jeu: The boyfriend announces proudly. The girlfriend screams with joy, then he presents one brick with a red ribbon.

persos.nom: the geography teacher
persos.desc: female teacher in her 30s, glasses, orange wax dress, pointing stick
persos.pose: pointing at the map of Cote d'Ivoire

persos.nom: the boy in the back row

persos.pose: raising his hand with confidence

jeu: The teacher points at the map. The boy answers proudly, counting on his fingers, and the class bursts out laughing.

lieu: primary school classroom in Abobo, Abidjan, teacher's desk with a stack of notebooks

persos.nom: the strict teacher
persos.desc: strict male teacher in his 50s, grey safari suit, chalk dust on his hands
persos.pose: holding out his hand for the homework

persos.desc: little girl around 9, blue uniform, white headband, innocent face
persos.pose: hands behind her back, innocent face

persos.pose: raising his finger like a lawyer

Merci. Je n'ai pas fait mes devoirs.

persos.nom: the teacher with the red pen
persos.desc: male teacher in his 40s, white shirt, red pen, suspicious look

persos.nom: the headmaster with the files
persos.desc: headmaster in his 50s, dark suit, thick glasses, stack of files
persos.pose: pointing at the empty chair

persos.nom: the boy in the khaki uniform
persos.desc: boy around 11, khaki uniform, standing straight
persos.pose: answering calmly

dialogue: Pourquoi ton père n'est pas venu à la réunion ?
Il dit que lui, il a déjà fini l'école.
jeu: The headmaster points at the empty chair. The boy answers calmly, repeating his father's words.
